thesis: Luke Ellis describes his early career progression from managing a small, losing equity derivative business at J.P. Morgan to leaving that role after six months with a new boss to join a fund of funds. He notes that the fund of funds business grew from 50 million to 15 billion in assets under management during his decade there before he decided to sell the business because it had reached its limits as an independent entity.
